# Support

Need help with Servio Social? Here's where to look:

- **Setup & configuration** — [docs/SETUP.md](../docs/SETUP.md)
- **How it works / architecture** — [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- **Testing without posting** — [docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md](../docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md)
- **A bug or a feature idea** — open an issue using the templates
- **A security concern** — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) (report privately)

This is a small hobby-scale project maintained in spare time, so please be
patient with responses.
